description: Live divergence engine — fires inside unresolved friction (stuck, entangled, dissonant) and fans successor questions from *within* the friction's own domain. Not a fixed taxonomy: reads the node, discovers which branch families are actually live, and surfaces only those. Invoke with /ramify, "ramify this", "I'm stuck", "open this up", "branch this friction". Fires during friction, not after resolution (that's the Flywheel) and not on clean binary forks (that's occams-razor). Complement of /fan: ramify stays inside the friction's domain; /fan exits to exogenous domains.
